title: Self-service onboarding and billing
summary: Self-service onboarding and billing is published as PR #279 at 7ee3a799912ea61eed1e5bed772474c704ea5334. Database Contract, Vercel, and external review checks are green, but check:ci fails in verify-production-rpc-inventory because provision_payment_ready_onboarding_intent is listed in the production RPC allowlist without a positive production invocation count.
reviewState: PR #279 requires an onboarding-branch fix for production RPC inventory drift: provision_payment_ready_onboarding_intent allowlist entry has no production .rpc call count. After fixing, rerun CI/MRR as needed; approval/merge remains user-gated.
